sentences.text: Key ideas
sentences.say: Key ideas

sentences.text: Supervised learning learns from examples with the right answer.
sentences.say: Supervised learning learns from examples with the right answer.

sentences.text: Its two tasks are regression (predict a number) and classification (predict a category).
sentences.say: Its two tasks are regression (predict a number) and classification (predict a category).

sentences.text: Unsupervised learning has no answers and finds structure: clusters, unusual cases, simpler descriptions.
sentences.say: Unsupervised learning has no answers and finds structure: clusters, unusual cases, simpler descriptions.

sentences.text: Reinforcement learning learns from rewards by trial and error.
sentences.say: Reinforcement learning learns from rewards by trial and error.

sentences.text: The first question to ask about any problem is: do I have the right answers for past cases?

sentences.text: Read the map from left to right.

sentences.text: 2.1 Supervised learning
sentences.say: 2.1 Supervised learning

sentences.text: In supervised learning each training example is a pair: an input x and the right answer y (the label).
sentences.say: In supervised learning each training example is a pair: an input times and the right answer y (the label).

sentences.text: The algorithm learns the mapping from x to y, so that it can predict y for an input it has never seen.
sentences.say: The algorithm learns the mapping from times to y, so that it can predict y for an input it has never seen.

sentences.text: Ng says that about 99% of the economic value created by machine learning today comes from this family.
sentences.say: Ng says that about 99 percent of the economic value created by machine learning today comes from this family.

sentences.text: It comes in two tasks:
sentences.say: It comes in two tasks:

sentences.text: Regression predicts a number from infinitely many possible values.
sentences.say: Regression predicts a number from infinitely many possible values.

sentences.text: A house price from its size.
sentences.say: A house price from its size.

sentences.text: A monthly loan cost from the amount and the term.
sentences.say: A monthly loan cost from the amount and the term.

sentences.text: Classification predicts a category from a small set.
sentences.say: Classification predicts a category from a small set.

sentences.text: Spam or not spam.
sentences.say: Spam or not spam.

sentences.text: A tumour that is benign (0) or malignant (1).
sentences.say: A tumour that is benign (0) or malignant (1).

sentences.text: The classes need not be numbers (cat or dog), and there can be more than two (Gmail's tabs: primary, social, promotions).

sentences.text: 2.2 Unsupervised learning
sentences.say: 2.2 Unsupervised learning

sentences.text: The data has inputs only.

sentences.text: Nobody tells the algorithm what the answers are, so it looks for structure by itself.

sentences.text: Ng's examples: Google News puts articles that share words (panda, twins, zoo) into one group; researchers group people by DNA activity; DeepLearning.AI found three learner segments (growing skills, developing a career, staying updated).

sentences.text: Anomaly detection: find unusual examples, such as fraud.
